# Bartosz Osiej — Docs

> Central documentation hub for FastAPI-url (LinkShort), Factorio-web-game (Novactorio) and NV2 Engine.

This site is fully readable by AI agents. For a single-file snapshot of all
content, fetch `/Docs/llms-full.txt`.

## Projects

- [LinkShort (FastAPI-url)](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/projects/fastapi-url/): Production-ready URL shortener — FastAPI, JWT auth, click tracking, React 19 SPA, SQLite.
  - [Getting Started](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/projects/fastapi-url/getting-started)
  - [API Reference](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/projects/fastapi-url/api-reference)
  - [Deployment](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/projects/fastapi-url/deployment)
- [Novactorio (Factorio-web-game)](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/projects/factorio-web-game/): Browser factory-automation game — hand-written Canvas 2D engine, TypeScript, Supabase co-op, Stripe premium.
  - [Architecture](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/projects/factorio-web-game/architecture)
  - [Gameplay Systems](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/projects/factorio-web-game/gameplay)
  - [Backend & Monetization](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/projects/factorio-web-game/backend)
- [NV2 Engine (NV2_ENGINE)](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/projects/nv2-engine/): Native Rust voxel engine — wgpu rendering, procedural biomes, AI-trained vegetation, full gameplay loop.
  - [Architecture](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/projects/nv2-engine/architecture)
  - [Gameplay](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/projects/nv2-engine/gameplay)
  - [AI Vegetation System](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/projects/nv2-engine/ai)
  - [Performance](https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Docs/projects/nv2-engine/performance)
